## Choose what you want to present, teach, or explore.

Independent presentations and workbenches share the same scientific tools.
Read the slides without starting a calculation; launch an isolated application
when you want live views, then explicitly select and prepare its workers.

The public pages remain usable when a numerical process or the broker is
unavailable.
